newsitem.title: USA: Leap Group to buy back up to 1 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Leap Group to buy back up to 1 mln shares.

text.p: Leap Group Inc, a marketing and advertising company, said Tuesday its board had approved the repurchase of up to one million shares.
The board placed a $3 million cap on the repurchase, the company said.
Shares of Leap, which had 14 million average weighted shares outstanding in the first quarter ended April 30, were up 1/2 at 3-1/4.
The company today reported a net loss of $1.2 million, or $0.08 a share, for the quarter. Its operating loss was $2.3 million.

"Leap's first quarter operating results reflect the investments we are making to build our company as we continue to cultivate business opportunities with new and existing clients," Leap Group Chief Executive R. Steven Lutterbach said in a news release.

Quantum Leap Communications, Leap's new media subsidiary, was launched in January. In April Leap completed the acquisition of Y A R Communications, a multicultural brand management agency based in New York.
